entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Mark. I've pulled up your order. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not working. I've tried everything, and it just won't sync with my phone or the app. It's useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the sync feature. So you believe the device itself is broken?
Yes. It seems defective. I just want to send it back.
Okay, I understand. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, thank you for waiting, Mark. I've reviewed your order date, and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Fine. So you're just going to take it back?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. I guess that's one way to solve a problem. Just send the email.
The email is on its way. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good day.
